headline: Play Half-Life 2 in your browser at over 100 FPS with save states
summary: A new, unofficial port of Half-Life 2 runs in-browser with WebGL 2
details: The port, developed by Slqnt and 98006, recreates the entire main campaign of Half-Life 2, including two episodic DLCs. It features save states, console support, and built-in achievements.
The game runs natively on your computer using WebGL 2 and WebAssembly, allowing for over 100 FPS on capable hardware. A virtual file system enables saving and loading.
The port was developed in just three months and has survived two weeks online despite being unofficial. It may be subject to a DMCA takedown from Valve.

headline_marked: Google Keep [[integrates Gemini AI]] for quick note access
headline: Google Keep integrates Gemini AI for quick note access
summary: Google Keep now uses Gemini AI for faster note retrieval on Android, making it a smart note-taking app.
details: Google Keep, a popular note-taking app, has integrated Gemini AI to enhance its functionality on Android devices. This integration allows users to quickly access specific notes using natural language queries.

The app now supports features like extracting text from images of handwritten notes and setting location-based reminders. Users can also ask Gemini to find specific details from their notes and share them directly.
While OneNote remains a powerful note-taking app, especially on desktop and tablet, Google Keep's new AI capabilities make it more useful for quick note retrieval on Android phones.
